{{Quote|The GGF is the future of combat arena entertainment, the greatest monsters, the greatest killers, the greatest warriors, and the greatest bloodshed coming together to put a smile on your face(s).|Mettez Roi|<ref name="HNN53" />}}
'''Mettez Roi''' was a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] promoter for the [[Galaxy Gladiator Federation]].<ref name="HNN53" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|news/13425_1.html|Proposed Galaxy Gladiator Federation Falling Apart}} takes place on the date 13:4:25, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Roi began to coordinate previously underground gladiatorial matches with the GGF using [[Gladiator droid/Legends|gladiator droids]], but received pushback from non-[[Droid/Legends|droid]] gladiators who believed it would hurt the integrity of the sport.<ref name="HNN53" />
